promotions.title: Filter Friday
promotions.body: Every Friday we give away about 10 yearly Pro promo codes. Subscribe to our mailing list so you find out if you won.

promotions.title: Pricing Goes Up
promotions.body: The price of Opta Pro goes up in steps as we hit subscriber milestones, so the earliest subscribers pay the least. Founders (first 1000): Yearly €5, Monthly €0.99, Lifetime €15. Early Bird (next 1000): Yearly €10, Monthly €1.99, Lifetime €25. Launch Week (next 1000): Yearly €15, Monthly €2.99, Lifetime €35. After that: Yearly €20, Monthly €3.99, Lifetime €45.

promotions.title: Tag Us, Win a Code
promotions.body: Tag us in a post shot with Opta to enter our weekly raffle for Pro promo codes.
